description: Synthetic NEI transcripts (fictional bands, no real material): a unique linear chain of five appearances – starter question, four answered links, the last question stays open. Format of saved MCP get_transcript results.

lines: 0.00-3.20 S2: Hi, we are Glass Harbor and this is the Never Ending Interview.
3.20-6.10 S2: We start it, so we get to ask the very first question.
6.10-11.40 S2: Our question for the next band is: if your tour bus could talk, what would it complain about?
11.40-13.00 S2: Good luck with that one!
0.00-2.50 S1: Welcome to the Never Ending Interview.
2.50-5.00 S2: Thanks, we're Velvet Coyote from Leeds.
5.00-8.20 S1: This question comes from Glass Harbor.
8.20-12.00 S1: If your tour bus could talk, what would it complain about?
12.00-19.50 S2: Oh man, it would complain about the smell. Definitely the socks of our drummer.
19.50-26.00 S2: And about the fact that we never let it sleep, we drive every night.
26.00-29.00 S1: Now you get to ask a question for the next band.
29.00-34.40 S2: Okay. My question for the next band is: what is the worst haircut you ever had on tour?
0.00-2.80 S2: Hello, we are Iron Lullaby.
2.80-6.00 S1: Your question is from Velvet Coyote: what is the worst haircut you ever had on tour?
6.00-14.00 S2: Ha! Our bassist cut my hair in a hotel bathroom in Prague. I looked like a broom for three weeks.
14.00-17.00 S1: So, do you have a question for the next band?
17.00-22.30 S2: I want to know: which song would you never ever play again?
0.00-2.40 S2: This is Neon Burial!
2.40-6.20 S1: The question comes from Iron Lullaby. Which song would you never ever play again?
6.20-15.10 S2: Our first single. We played it four hundred times and nobody liked it, not even our mums.
15.10-18.00 S1: Now you can ask a question for the next band.
18.00-23.00 S2: My question for the next band is: what do you eat right before a show?
0.00-2.60 S2: Hi, we're Paper Wolves.
2.60-6.50 S1: This question is from Neon Burial: what do you eat right before a show?
6.50-13.80 S2: Nothing. If I eat before a show I throw up on the first row. Bananas after, though.
13.80-16.20 S1: And now you get to ask the next band.
16.20-21.00 S2: My question for the next band is: who in your band snores the loudest?
